download_all_videos_from_s3: download all videos from S3 to a local folder using a thread pool executor with callbacks
filter_already_downloaded_videos: filter out videos that are already downloaded by checking S3 version and file size
list_videos_for_download: list videos from a manifest filtered by benchmarks, universities, or specific video UIDs
list_corrupt_downloaded_files: list downloaded files that appear corrupted by comparing local file size to S3 content size
load_and_save_version_entries: load or save version entries to a CSV file tracking downloaded video UIDs and versions
